title: Native Q8 AVX2 row timing derived statistics

method.pairedSpeedup: The raw runner forms nine paired ratios per case from ABBA/BAAB rounds and reports their median as baseline time divided by candidate time. Values above 1 favor the candidate.
method.absoluteNsPerRow: Each round has four serial calls. For even rounds, baseline uses indices 0 and 3 and candidate uses 1 and 2. For odd rounds, baseline uses 1 and 2 and candidate uses 0 and 3. Each arm therefore has 18 observations per case. Sort the 18 values, average indices 8 and 9 for a conventional median, then divide by rowCallsPerSample. Group absolute values are the median of the case-level arm medians.
method.originalSummary: Original runs-v1/summary.json and runs-v2/summary.json are retained unchanged. Their baselineMedianNsPerRow and candidateMedianNsPerRow fields use the upper middle of 18 observations. This file supplies corrected conventional medians from the original roundsNs arrays.
